items.title: Delivery and assembly of wardrobe
items.quote: Wir liefern und montieren ihn am Samstag, 12.12.2026; unser Team ist ab 08:00 Uhr bei Ihnen und braucht etwa drei Stunden.
items.computation: The letter states the delivery and assembly date directly as Saturday, 12.12.2026, with the team arriving from 08:00. No counting rule is needed; the date is fixed and printed in the letter.

items.title: Call to reschedule the delivery date if it does not suit
items.quote: Passt Ihnen der Tag nicht, rufen Sie uns spätestens drei Werktage vorher an.
items.computation: The appointment is Saturday 12.12.2026. 'Drei Werktage vorher' counts Werktage (Monday to Saturday, Sundays and public holidays excluded) backwards from the appointment day, which itself is not counted: 11.12.2026 (Fri) = 1st Werktag before, 10.12.2026 (Thu) = 2nd, 09.12.2026 (Wed) = 3rd. No public holiday falls in this window in NW. So the call must reach the company by 09.12.2026 at the latest.
